local function toggleBtn(txt,y,default)
	local on = default
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton", scroll)
	b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(500,36)
	b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10,y)
	b.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(40,90,40) or Color3.fromRGB(55,55,55)
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
	b.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	b.TextSize = 15
	b.Text = txt.." : "..(on and "ON" or "OFF")
	b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		on = not on
		b.Text = txt.." : "..(on and "ON" or "OFF")
		b.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(40,90,40) or Color3.fromRGB(55,55,55)
	end)
	return function() return on end
end

-- Anti‑Sit / Bang / Fling
local lastAlert = 0
local function alertOnce(msg)
	if tick() - lastAlert > 2 then
		lastAlert = tick()
		notify(msg)
	end
end

	if not char or not hum or not hrp then return end

	-- Anti‑Sit (يمنع الجلوس نهائيًا حتى تطفيه)
	if antiSitOn() and hum.Sit then
		hum.Sit = false
		hrp.Velocity = Vector3.zero
		alertOnce("محاولة إجلاس عليك ❌")
	end

	-- Anti‑Bang / Fling (قص السرعة/الدوران العالي)
	if (antiBangOn() or antiFlingOn()) then
		if hrp.Velocity.Magnitude > 65 or hrp.RotVelocity.Magnitude > 65 then
			hrp.Velocity = Vector3.zero
			hrp.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
			alertOnce("محاولة Bang / Fling ❌")
		end
	end
end)
